title: Placement
description: Where an artifact sits in the world: p_enu = scale * R_enu_artifact * p_artifact + t_enu_artifact, in the local ENU frame at `anchor`.

anchor.description: ENU origin; null for an artifact in a local frame.

R_enu_artifact.description: Row-major 3x3 rotation, any proper rotation including an axis permutation.

scale.description: Uniform scale from artifact units to metres.
